dish.note: Tinned peaches under a buttery oat crumble, with cream. Pantry food, done well.
dish.how: Tip 2 x 410g tins of peach slices (drained) into a baking dish with 2 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon. Rub 100g cold butter into 120g plain flour, 80g rolled oats and 80g brown sugar, scatter over the peaches and bake at 180C for 35 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve with cream.

ingredients.item: tins peach slices (410 g each), drained

steps.text: Tip the drained peaches into a baking dish with the sugar and cinnamon.
Rub the butter into the flour, oats and brown sugar and scatter over the fruit.
Bake at 180C until golden and bubbling.
Rest 5 minutes and serve with cream.

dish.make_ahead: Assemble up to 4 hours ahead and bake just before serving
